description: This is a unit test source file for the PimCsvDataImport class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases to validate the import process of employee data from CSV format, including validation and integration with services and DAOs.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing various scenarios of the PimCsvDataImport class, including validation, service interaction, and handling of edge cases.

methods.name: testGetNationalityService
methods.description: Verifies that getNationalityService() returns an instance of NationalityService.

methods.name: testGetCountryService
methods.description: Checks that getCountryService() correctly returns an instance of CountryService with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: testIsValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Tests the phone number validation method with valid and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessful
methods.description: Tests successful import of employee data, verifying integration with services and data persistence logic.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessfulWhenGenderValueChanges
methods.description: Checks import when the gender value differs, ensuring correct handling and service calls.

methods.name: testImportWhenFirstNameNotExist
methods.description: Validates that import fails if the first name is missing.

methods.name: testImportWhenLastNameNotExist
methods.description: Validates that import fails if the last name is missing.

methods.name: testImportWhenEmployeeIdDuplicated
methods.description: Tests behavior when importing employees with duplicated employee IDs, ensuring unique constraints are enforced.
